Class Question

java.lang.Object
application.Question
public class Question extends Object
Creates the Question class that contains all necessary data types for Question objects to function. Contains setters and getters for all necessary variables.

    • Question

      public Question(int id, String title, String question, String userName, Boolean resolved, Boolean isSubQuestion, int parentQuestionLinkId, Boolean hideUserName, int preferredAnswerId)
      Constructor for creating of a question FOR AFTER it is already in the database, this is for taking it out of the database and creating the question objects from the stored info.
      Parameters:
      id - Integer with the question's id number.
      title - String containing the title.
      question - String containing the question.
      userName - String containing the userName.
      resolved - Boolean that states whether a question is resolved or not.
      isSubQuestion - Boolean for whether the question is a sub question.
      hideUserName - Boolean for whether it should be anonymous.
      preferredAnswerId - Integer with the preferred answers ID.
      parentQuestionLinkID - Integer containing the parents QuestionLinkID.
